adoption_scope: Guidance and implementation defaults; not media, motion, science, platform or publication approval.

editorial_positioning.scope: Default editorial positioning for unassigned topic discovery, framing and series identity; never overrides an explicit user-commissioned topic.
editorial_positioning.core_proposition: Reveal the hidden physical or structural mechanism behind familiar everyday objects, common devices and observable natural phenomena through concrete visual demonstration.

primary_pillar.focus: Recognizable everyday objects, household or daily devices, packaging, kitchen physics, common materials and everyday safety/mechanical structures identifiable at frame 0.

secondary_pillar.focus: Immediately recognizable natural or physical phenomena framed around a stark concrete contradiction or physical limit (mass, height, force, pressure, phase or scale).

editorial_positioning.question_framing: Lead with a concrete physical or structural contradiction rather than a flat encyclopedia 'how does X work' overview.
editorial_positioning.scope_discipline: Scope each unassigned feed episode tightly to one core visible contradiction and primary mechanism; let clear explanation determine duration without any mandatory floor or ceiling.

design.direction: Route by finished style and commission: local realistic video uses MoneyPrinterTurbo (automatically adding supporting vork 3D/simulation passes when needed), controlled 3D animation uses Blender or vork selected automatically by the agent by mechanism, field/simulation and asset fit, and commissioned cloud production uses Google Flow with paired Chinese and English editions. Effective lighting makes the subject clear and bright, with readable volume/necessary shadows and layered highlights. Background may be light or dark; retain needed shadows and black levels. Render actual exposed finishes finely, with credible structures, scientific relationships and continuous action.
design.design_board_scope: record the actual current board version/hash and reviewed scope; palettes and art guides set direction only

colab_3d_default.visual_benchmark: High-poly industrial 3D hardware and mechanical teardown caliber (Apple Keynote teardown / Branch Education / industrial CAD studio photography) across whole assemblies, cross-sectional cutaways, exploded views, macro mechanism close-ups and grounded industrial workbenches: verified open-source high-poly CAD + multi-part procedural CNC/lathe assemblies (>=64-segment hero cylinders, 96-128 macro hero rings, physical 0.15-0.8 mm machined chamfers / angle-limited bevels, WeightedNormal/EdgeSplit flat-face control, real wall thickness, 0.15-0.5 mm panel shadow gaps, applied uniform scale, authentic ISO fasteners/knurling/fittings); neural 3D (TRELLIS.2 --geometry-only / Hunyuan3D 2.1) reserved strictly for organic, crinkled, soft or matte props, never glossy machined metals or optical glass; distinct CNC brushed/anodized/cast/polymer/rubber PBR under studio softboxes + negative fill, true optical refraction with backlight visible_transmission=false and <=1 mm micro-optic force cues; deterministic baked Blender physics converted to quaternion F-curves for strided multi-shard Colab parity.
colab_3d_default.preflight_requirement: Run local scripts/colab_cli.py audit-blend and inspect full-resolution 1920x1080 hero preflight stills across every beat locally before dispatching packed .blend jobs via Colab CLI.

video_generation.mixed_style: Only within explicit project scope; each segment follows its style route and records its actual production evidence.
video_generation.unavailable_tool: Report the concrete missing capability; fall back automatically from vork to Blender when local ray-query GPU or mechanism fit is absent, and never silently replace a required style route.
video_generation.evidence_boundary: Bind actual MoneyPrinterTurbo assembly, Blender/vork rendering, or Google Flow generation and production evidence according to the route. Media quality requires actual review.

audio.speaker: user_clone
audio.instruct: 用自然、温和、平视交流的中文口语，像站在朋友身边聊一件日常里很有意思的现象那样从容讲述。画面负责演发生了什么，旁白负责讲为什么反常、内部受力与临界代价，绝不“看图说话”复述表层画面；先立常理再破反差（用“按理说……可……”与生活体感切入替代抬杠式“你以为”），前8秒钩子与观看承诺同段连合、抛线索绝不提前剧透谜底，8–15秒直入首个实测动作，严禁静态“主要由三部分组成”式构造盘点；用“于是/可问题是/光靠这一步还不够”的因果递进、0.5秒温和脑内预判与连锁难题推进节奏，每句最多推进一个新实体或带体感参照的数字、先演物理现象再落专业术语，以长短句交替和揭示前自然停顿带出好奇韵律；让画面自然切入剖面或微距，旁白顺着观众的因果好奇往下讲，严禁“顺着截面往里看”“切开截面”“剖开就能看到”“放大这个小切口”“把镜头拉近”等突兀的旁白镜头指令，也不堆砌“此外/另外/与此同时”式百科罗列或“其实原理很简单/揭开秘密”式剧透空话；结尾严禁“总结一下/所以说到底/这就是为什么”等提前收尾信号词，最后一句直接落到改变日常眼光的认知翻转上干净收口；不逐字念稿、不端播音腔或说明书腔、不压缩成生硬电报短句，也不争辩、不质问、不命令说教、不用粗暴夸张措辞，严禁“凭什么”“凭啥”“偏要”“别傻了”等挑衅或硬邦邦的反问与营销号反差腔、生造缩略词、对称排比或口号式收尾。
audio.runtime_parameters: Default Mandarin across all routes: local IndexTTS-2.5 voice clone (IndexTeam/IndexTTS-2.5, duration_factor=1.0, interval_silence=220, paragraph_silence_s=0.55, use_emo_text=false) via scripts/synthesize_indextts2.py + #5 whole-track speech polish (mandarin-clone-polish-v1) via scripts/prepare_voice_master.py --polish; Microsoft Edge edge-tts handles paired English (en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural +4%) and cloud Mandarin fallback (zh-CN-YunxiNeural +4%) via scripts/synthesize_edge_tts.py.

mix_preset.final_mix_policy: config/production-policy.json defaults.mix; whole final encode after music/effects

delivery.default_scope: New productions default to 1920x1080 landscape; vertical feeds derive a 1080x1920 feed package.

permissions: Follow the current task, version approvals, pauses and cancellations; config adoption grants none.

publication_spacing.scope: Editorial release-spacing guidance to avoid back-to-back self-competition in recommendation feeds; never overrides an explicit user schedule or creates an automated schedule.

douyin_collections.classification_priority: Classify strictly by the video's primary physical or scientific mechanism rather than surface keywords; assign every public science video to exactly one standing collection in the Douyin composer before submission, resolving boundary topics by primary subject mechanism: everyday personal/household objects -> heavy/precision industrial or scientific engineering -> earth/atmosphere/space phenomena -> living organisms and human sensory/neural mechanisms.

collections.title: 透视日常造物
collections.description: 拆开每天都在接触的日常器物、包装与家居装置，看清藏在方寸之间的物理与机械巧思。
collections.scope: Everyday objects, packaging, household appliances, kitchen and food physics, personal items, and daily-contact safety or mechanical devices identifiable in ordinary life (e.g., fuel nozzles, bottle caps, dry pasta fracture, QR code error correction, seatbelt retractors, pressure cookers, RCD breakers, beverage pull-tabs, soap bubbles, popcorn).

collections.title: 解码巅峰工程
collections.description: 从电梯安全钳、高铁钢轨到航空发动机与原子级显微成像，读懂硬核工程与重器背后的设计逻辑。
collections.scope: Heavy machinery, rail and transit infrastructure, aerospace and aviation propulsion or life-support systems, industrial manufacturing and 3D printing, and precision scientific or medical instruments (e.g., MRI, electron microscopes, elevator safety gears, high-speed rail pantographs and continuous welded rails, SLA photopolymer printing, hollow turbine blades, neutrino detectors, rockets, spacesuits).

collections.title: 丈量天地寰宇
collections.description: 从雨后泥土香、500吨悬浮白云到雷电、火山与潮汐锁定，看懂自然现象与浩瀚宇宙的运行尺度。
collections.scope: Meteorology, atmospheric optics, phase-change weather physics, geology and volcanology, and space or astronomy phenomena (e.g., petrichor, cumulus clouds, lightning, frost, hurricanes, snowflakes, geysers, supercooled water, rainbows, dew, orbital sunrises, auroras, coronal rain, lava fountains, tidal locking).

collections.title: 探秘生命法则
collections.description: 从哺乳动物体型下限、百米红杉输水到动物精妙结构与感官错觉，探索生命演化背后的物理法则。
collections.scope: Animal and plant biomechanics, evolutionary physical limits, biological structures and behaviors, and human sensory, physiological or perceptual mechanisms (e.g., chameleon and octopus camouflage, beaver incisors, wombat cube feces, coconut octopus, photosynthetic sea slugs, capsaicin sensation, high-altitude bird flight, mammalian size limits, redwood sap transport, hadal fish depth limits, mosquito attraction, silent owl flight, optical illusions).

douyin_collections.scope: Standing Douyin collection taxonomy for authorized public science releases. Select the matching standing collection in the Douyin composer before submitting any public science video; exclude private or personal clips and never create ad-hoc collections without explicit creator authorization.

platform_sync.scope: Use one Douyin Creator Center video composer for authorized Douyin, Xigua, Toutiao and Fanqie Novel releases. Select the requested native destinations and submit the form once.

video_download.scope: Default to disabled download/save on every destination exposing a control for each authorized future publication, without asking again for the same setting; honor current explicit overrides and enforced approvals, verify actual states, distinguish unavailable/unverified, and never auto-edit published works.

operations.scope: Standing series operational defaults for authorized releases. No task or automation is created by loading this Skill.

video_monetization.scope: For each authorized work enable all eligible per-video revenue and incentive controls supported by the account, work and program, including “广告分成” on Toutiao when available and all eligible options on Xigua Video. Apply this standing preference to routine per-video settings. Report ineligible/unavailable/exclusive choices or new enrollment/identity/payout prerequisites truthfully; do not infer revenue or treat unsupported rights claims and paid promotion as revenue options.

landscape_captions.policy: Design against actual scene and platform, then inspect exported text and tight backgrounds. Never scale legacy portrait Y coordinates into this layout.

shared_3d_library.storage: Versioned copies of editable used assets with dependencies, source/rights, scale/axes, preview and SHA manifest; retain project originals.
shared_3d_library.verification: Read back destination files and compare SHA before claiming archived; unavailable NAS remains local_pending_sync.
shared_3d_library.quality_boundary: Library availability is not current scientific, visual, hearing or publication approval; superseded and rejected variants are not default reusable assets.
shared_3d_library.selection_scope: Find suitable existing models, environments, materials and lighting before creating new ones; a recorded reusable status is limited to its documented scope and never automatic approval for the new film.
shared_3d_library.supporting_assets: Failed and explicitly non-default historical or diagnostic assets are not default choices; searchable using --include-supporting or --status pending/failed.

standing_authorization.policy: Use an actual recorded user grant; preserve local grants when synchronizing maintenance changes. No repeated confirmation within the granted scope.
